DIAGNOSIS READY: Systemic Sclerosis (Limited Cutaneous Scleroderma) /CREST Syndrome

The combination of a longstanding pruritic rash, palmar numbness/tingling, and the suspicion of skin tightening or Raynaud's phenomenon strongly suggests systemic sclerosis.
